executive_summary: Net profit was INR 210,000.00 below budget, unfavorable, with INR 495,000.00 explained and INR 515,000.00 unexplained.

India Operations Distribution and Australia Sales Employee costs were the largest explained drivers, with India's distribution variance explained by urgent air freight and Australia's employee costs due to vacant roles.
India's Distribution had a net unfavorable movement of INR 240,000.00, partially offset by Singapore's Employee costs, which were neutral on plan.
The full-year effect of confirmed items is INR 465,000.00 above plan, assuming recurring items continue at this month's level.

lines.commentary: India Operations Distribution was INR 240,000.00 above budget, unfavorable, with INR 180,000.00 explained by urgent air freight for festive-season stock due to a supplier delay.
Australia Sales Employee costs were INR 150,000.00 below budget, favorable, fully explained by two vacant roles in the Sydney sales team.
Singapore Operations Employee costs were INR 90,000.00 below budget, favorable, fully explained by two warehouse supervisors moving to the Singapore Sales cost centre.
India Corporate Consulting was INR 75,000.00 above budget, unfavorable, fully explained by unbudgeted tax advisory support for the GST audit.
Australia Operations Distribution was INR 70,000.00 above budget, unfavorable, with no confirmed explanation.
India Sales Employee costs were INR 60,000.00 above budget, unfavorable, with no confirmed explanation.
